The replacement preserves the exact signature and required valid accesses while correctly removing the unsupported non-null return guarantee. contradictions.reason: Accept the joint-accessor supersession. Returning a stored pointer unchanged does not guarantee that pointer is non-null. Accept related Toy Fall constraint-direction and sequencing deferrals: accessor identity alone cannot establish hierarchy-operation direction or scene lifetime.

Accept rejection of the infinite-distance-bound claim: the initializer is F32_MAX and updates require strict inequality. Accept the damage-selector deferrals because the initial cutoff is 999 and accepted damage is assigned to an int threshold; an unqualified exact-minimum guarantee is too strong. Preserve uncertainty about the status flag, missile variant dispatch, broad caller inventories and external gameplay identities. Current left-stick access explicitly selects sample zero.

Accept all three guard-description rejections. The accepted set is GuardOn, Guard and GuardSetOff, whereas the separate transition selects GuardOff. Do not substitute an unverified positive gameplay explanation for GuardSetOff.

Accept the input-history qualification and conservative input-family deferrals. The setter resets before setting x221D_b4, while the inverse only clears it. Reset touches operative samples 0 and 1 and counters, not sample 2; processing preserves sampled values in slot 2 before neutralizing operative input. This corroborates a gating role but does not justify an unconditional restoration-of-control guarantee or erasure of all history. Cross-shard confirmations are not treated as new disposition overrides.

Accept compiled-section, exact-string, bit-width, destination-layout and register-binding deferrals. Assertion expansion and diagnostic consumption establish source-level flow, not emitted section identity, byte extent, padding, basename expansion or ABI. No compiled evidence was supplied to close those questions.

Accept the camera-domain and transitive-state deferrals. The wrapper delegates with zero margin, but the lower limit is adjusted using the first Ground output plus one, rather than solely the raw stage bottom. The restored 4498–4504 citation uses the exact pinned revision. Ground-helper semantics and transitive absence of mutation remain deferred. Stage identity, broader camera consumers and results-presentation chains are not proven by rendered names.

Accept item-association, possession-limit, cleanup and placement deferrals. The association predicate can match NULL against either stored slot, so actual holding and a universal one-item limit do not follow. Position replacement is direct; full results/Toy Fall placement semantics and Hammer-specific delegated cleanup require their own evidence. Preserve cross-file lifetime uncertainty rather than inferring destruction or release from rendered names.

Accept remaining hitlag, rumble, team-policy, nametag, unnamed-flag and player-identity deferrals. Local storage, guarded forwarding, exact truth tables and same-player comparison are supported, but they do not establish every asserted producer, scheduler argument meaning, event origin, character arrangement, storage declaration, global immutability or exhaustive consumer inventory. Stronger statements in individual functionality shards are bounded partial confirmations, not grounds to silently close the unresolved compound facts and links.

Accept exact FingerGun threshold/count deferral: the comparison is strictly greater than xEC, selecting xF0 versus 1, without establishing the configured values or gameplay bullet-pair counts. Accept reset-command, death-cleanup and Metal-detail deferrals: ordered wrapper calls and symbolic QuakeKind_Small do not independently establish command identity, downstream cleanup, numeric quake value or all parameter effects.

Accept throw, death-family, KO-attribution, bonus-event, revival-platform and numeric-motion gameplay deferrals. The throw predicate has no upper bound; the narrower death predicate begins at DeadUp rather than DeadDown. Exact interval tests and field reads do not establish all visible presentations, event categories or character-specific lifetime meanings. Partial caller confirmations in other shards do not establish the missing transition/rendering or event-dispatch evidence.

Accept costume/audio, discriminator, item-batch and resource-use deferrals. The crowd special case uses costume >= 2, not an explicit two-value set; colors, leadership and audible content remain unverified. A player-associated field return does not establish its representation or expanded MinorSlot meaning. Forwarding item batches and loading cached resources do not alone establish Party Ball provenance, Adventure use or copied-move availability before gameplay consumption.

Accept animation-wrapper and smash-state deferrals. The actual wrapper is void and has no return statement, despite its rendered predicate-style name; Boolean ABI, residual return propagation and results-capture behavior are not established. smash_attrs.state == 2 is explicit, but charge-hold identity, forward-smash provenance and caller uniqueness require separate evidence.

Accept Kirby/Game & Watch destination-representation and copied-article provenance deferrals. The primary Kirby callback writes through ArticleDynamicBones**, while the secondary callback writes through s32*. These definitions do not independently establish a unified four-byte color representation, diffuse-material operation or copied-neutral-special constructor chain. The proposal appropriately makes no change to these uncertain interfaces.

All enumerated unresolved facts and links retain their upstream deferral, not a finding that the underlying relationship is false. Historical missing caller paths, unverified wrapper bridges, character/gameplay mappings, resource consumers and exhaustive-reference assertions remain outstanding even where other shards partially corroborate a chain. This reconciles the document's bounded observations with the proposal's single supported correction. Supported retained knowledge is explicitly inherited unchanged; acceptance covers this change and the examined contradictions, not a new audit of every retained row.
